title: Other people in a person's conversation: what is shared with me
description: Root: the reply of GET /api/v1/shared (ADR 0038 section 7), the conversations other people on the server have invited the signed-in person into. It comes from the gateway's participation index: metadata only, never a message, a role or a permission, and never the owner's Unix name or the conversation's ID. A participant reaches a share only through /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/<operation>; the gateway routes that to the owner's guest socket, whose daemon decides from its own membership record. An unknown, removed or foreign share_id is resource_not_found, the same as a missing one.

shareId.description: An opaque random ID the gateway gave this invitation. It names no person, conversation or Unix user.

share.description: invited: the person may only join (Liity); nothing of the conversation shows before. joined: the person is in the conversation.

join.description: The reply of POST /api/v1/shared/<share_id>/join, after the owner's daemon accepted the join on its guest socket.

participant.description: The decoded value of the Open-Habitat-Participant header the gateway sends on the owner's guest socket, base64url without padding: who is speaking, from the authenticated session alone. It is identity, never permission; the daemon refuses it on every other socket.
